moves.name: Reverse crunch

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan curling his hips off the mat

cues: Lie on your back, knees bent.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Lower slowly. Don't swing your legs.

moves.name: Toe touch

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan reaching for his toes, legs up

cues: Legs straight up in the air.
Reach for your toes. Shoulder blades off the floor.
Squeeze at the top, then come down slowly.

recap.title: Screenshot this.
recap.note: Both, every day, at the end of your workout.
recap.text: These build the muscle. Your diet burns the fat on top of it. Send this to a friend whose lower abs won't show.
